column1: # Brand keyword → the brand's official registrable domains (per SPEC.md `domain`, using psl_lite_v1.txt).
# Format: keyword<TAB>official1,official2,...[<TAB>sub|word] (lowercase). Matching follows SPEC.md brand_lookalike: keywords of
# >= 5 chars match as substrings of the host; shorter ones only match a whole host word (host split on . and -),
# because short brands are substrings of ordinary words (ups→groups, irs→critairs, amex→aramex, nab→personab).
# The usps-/-usps/usps. rows recover common glued USPS look-alikes that the whole-word rule would miss.
# Generic words (discover, target-like retail words) are only listed when look-alike risk outweighs collisions.
# --- International brands frequent in the training corpora
